statements.t: With emerging data continuing to inform our next steps, potential therapeutic applications and paths forward, we will provide a comprehensive overview of the program in the coming months.”

Utilizing our fully annotated library of 15,000+ integrin binding molecules, as well as our biological knowledge of cell-specific integrin receptor expression, Pliant has created a selective, targeted integrin-mediated delivery platform for cell- and tissue-selective extrahepatic delivery of drug payloads, including RNAi.
In non-human primate studies, we have observed >75% target gene knockdown at eight weeks while avoiding liver and other non-targeted tissues.

• Initial Indications – Based on early findings showing the successful selective delivery of Pliant’s skeletal and cardiac muscle compounds, the Company plans to accelerate development with initial therapeutic programs focused in areas of high unmet need including neuromuscular diseases and rare cardiomyopathies where gene suppression modalities show promise.
